description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeBulkLeaveRequestAPI class, which is part of the OrangeHRM human resource management system. The class provides an API endpoint for bulk operations on leave requests (approve, cancel, reject) of employees. It extends the Endpoint class, implements ResourceEndpoint, and uses traits for leave request handling, authorization, and ORM interactions. The main method is 'update', which processes bulk leave request actions by validating, checking permissions, and updating the leave request statuses.

classes.name: EmployeeBulkLeaveRequestAPI
classes.description: A PHP class representing an API endpoint in OrangeHRM for bulk processing of employee leave requests, including bulk approval, cancellation, and rejection. It handles validation and authorization, and performs transactional updates to leave request statuses.
